content: {"SQLTemplate":"使用当前公司销售出货语义：delivery_time 有值才算出货；金额使用 t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total'；员工 t_order.sale_staff_id=t_profile.user_id；国家 t_order.shipping_address=t_address.id；产品 t_order_item.sku_id=t_item.id。"}

{"intent":"出单价值","SQLTemplate":"SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t_order.delivery_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales_amount FROM t_order JOIN t_profile ON t_order.sale_staff_id = t_profile.user_id JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id = t_order.id WHERE t_profile.real_name = {{employee_name}} AND t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code = 'sub_total' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month"}

{"SQLTemplate":"SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t_order.delivery_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(t_order_sales_profit.qty*(t_order_sales_profit.sale_price-t_order_sales_profit.purchase_price)) AS profit FROM t_order JOIN t_profile ON t_order.sale_staff_id=t_profile.user_id JOIN t_order_sales_profit ON t_order_sales_profit.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_profile.real_name={{employee_name}} AND t_order.delivery_time \u003e= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time \u003c {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month","intent":"利润,毛利,赚了多少,利润多少"}

{"intent":"国家","SQLTemplate":"SELECT COALESCE(t_address.country_code,'未知') AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count FROM t_order JOIN t_profile ON t_order.sale_staff_id=t_profile.user_id LEFT JOIN t_address ON t_order.shipping_address=t_address.id WHERE t_profile.real_name={{employee_name}} AND t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 GROUP BY country ORDER BY order_count DESC"}

{"SQLTemplate":"SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t_order.delivery_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count FROM t_order JOIN t_profile ON t_order.sale_staff_id=t_profile.user_id WHERE t_profile.real_name={{employee_name}} AND t_order.delivery_time \u003e= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time \u003c {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month","intent":"卖多少单,多少单,出了多少单,订单数,单量"}

{"SQLTemplate":"SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t_order.delivery_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales_amount FROM t_order JOIN t_profile ON t_order.sale_staff_id=t_profile.user_id JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_profile.real_name={{employee_name}} AND t_order.delivery_time \u003e= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time \u003c {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month","intent":"销售额,卖多少钱,销售金额,业绩,卖了多少钱,累计多少钱"}

{"SQLTemplate":"SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t_order.delivery_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales_amount FROM t_order JOIN t_profile ON t_order.sale_staff_id=t_profile.user_id JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_profile.real_name={{employee_name}} AND t_order.delivery_time \u003e= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time \u003c {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day","intent":"按天销售分布,按天销量,每日销量,每天卖了多少"}

{"intent":"经营报告","SQLTemplate":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales_amount, SUM(t_order_sales_profit.qty*t_order_sales_profit.purchase_price) AS cost_amount, SUM(t_order_sales_profit.qty*(t_order_sales_profit.sale_price-t_order_sales_profit.purchase_price)) AS gross_profit FROM t_order JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id LEFT JOIN t_order_sales_profit ON t_order_sales_profit.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total'"}

{"intent":"国家","SQLTemplate":"SELECT COALESCE(t_address.country_code,'未知') AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales_amount FROM t_order LEFT JOIN t_address ON t_order.shipping_address=t_address.id JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY country ORDER BY sales_amount DESC"}

{"intent":"城市","SQLTemplate":"SELECT COALESCE(t_address.city,'未知') AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales_amount FROM t_order LEFT JOIN t_address ON t_order.shipping_address=t_address.id JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC"}

{"intent":"员工排行","SQLTemplate":"SELECT t_profile.real_name AS employee, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales_amount FROM t_order JOIN t_profile ON t_order.sale_staff_id=t_profile.user_id JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY employee ORDER BY sales_amount DESC"}

{"intent":"城市","SQLTemplate":"SELECT COALESCE(t_address.city,'未知') AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales_amount FROM t_order JOIN t_profile ON t_order.sale_staff_id=t_profile.user_id LEFT JOIN t_address ON t_order.shipping_address=t_address.id JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_profile.real_name={{employee_name}} AND t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC"}

{"intent":"分类","SQLTemplate":"SELECT COALESCE(t_item.item_type_inventory_category,'未知分类') AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count, SUM(t_order_item.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales_amount FROM t_order JOIN t_order_item ON t_order_item.order_id=t_order.id LEFT JOIN t_item ON t_order_item.sku_id=t_item.id JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY category ORDER BY sales_amount DESC"}

{"intent":"sku","SQLTemplate":"SELECT COALESCE(t_item.shop_sku,t_item.shop_sku_id,t_order_item.sku_id) AS sku, COALESCE(t_item.title,'未知产品') AS title, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS order_count, SUM(t_order_item.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(t_order_item.price*t_order_item.quantity) AS item_sales_amount FROM t_order JOIN t_order_item ON t_order_item.order_id=t_order.id LEFT JOIN t_item ON t_order_item.sku_id=t_item.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 GROUP BY sku,title ORDER BY item_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 50"}

{"intent":"sku利润","SQLTemplate":"SELECT COALESCE(t_item.shop_sku,t_item.shop_sku_id,t_order_sales_profit.sku_id) AS sku, COALESCE(t_item.title,'未知产品') AS title, SUM(t_order_sales_profit.qty) AS quantity, SUM(t_order_sales_profit.qty*t_order_sales_profit.sale_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(t_order_sales_profit.qty*t_order_sales_profit.purchase_price) AS cost_amount, SUM(t_order_sales_profit.qty*(t_order_sales_profit.sale_price-t_order_sales_profit.purchase_price)) AS gross_profit FROM t_order_sales_profit JOIN t_order ON t_order_sales_profit.order_id=t_order.id LEFT JOIN t_item ON t_order_sales_profit.sku_id=t_item.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 GROUP BY sku,title ORDER BY gross_profit DESC LIMIT 50"}

{"intent":"客户","SQLTemplate":"SELECT COALESCE(t_member.company_name,t_member.name,'未知客户') AS customer, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS orders, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales FROM t_order JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id LEFT JOIN t_member ON t_order.vip_id=t_member.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY customer ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 20"}

{"intent":"库存","SQLTemplate":"SELECT 'supplier' AS type, COALESCE(t_supplier.name,t_supplier.company_name,'未知供应商') AS name, SUM(t_purchase_item.quantity) AS qty FROM t_purchase_item JOIN t_purchase ON t_purchase_item.purchase_id=t_purchase.id LEFT JOIN t_supplier ON t_purchase.supplier_id=t_supplier.id WHERE t_purchase.created_at >= {{start_date}} AND t_purchase.created_at < {{end_date}} GROUP BY name ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 20"}

{"intent":"经营分析","SQLTemplate":"SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t_order.delivery_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS orders, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales, SUM(t_order_sales_profit.qty*(t_order_sales_profit.sale_price-t_order_sales_profit.purchase_price)) AS profit FROM t_order JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id LEFT JOIN t_order_sales_profit ON t_order_sales_profit.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month"}

{"intent":"经营分析","SQLTemplate":"SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t_order.delivery_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT t_order.id) AS orders, SUM(t_order_amount.amount) AS sales, SUM(t_order_sales_profit.qty*(t_order_sales_profit.sale_price-t_order_sales_profit.purchase_price)) AS profit FROM t_order JOIN t_order_amount ON t_order_amount.order_id=t_order.id LEFT JOIN t_order_sales_profit ON t_order_sales_profit.order_id=t_order.id WHERE t_order.delivery_time >= {{start_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time < {{end_date}} AND t_order.delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND t_order.order_status != 0 AND t_order_amount.fee_code='sub_total' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month"}
